evidence.observation: Growth pressure was 3.006 Torr at nominally constant temperature and argon flow.
Pressure reached 3.196 Torr, above the preceding approximately 3.03 Torr baseline, while temperature was 750.4 C and argon flow 99.8 sccm against setpoints of 750 C and 100 sccm.
No exhaust oxygen sensor is installed; pressure and argon readings cannot verify atmosphere composition.

args.missing_evidence: Independent pressure confirmation and checks of exhaust conductance and system leak integrity are needed to identify the cause of the pressure rise; oxygen measurement is needed to verify atmosphere purity. No sample characterization is available.
